title: Bolsista Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial - Lopes Alimentos - Mapeamento e Gestão de Processos
description:
A Fundação Araucária, em parceria com o IEL Paraná, oferece às empresas paranaenses um programa inovador que conecta seu negócio a doutores profissionais. O Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial oportunizará expertise técnica, científica e metodológica, essenciais para impulsionar o crescimento, a inovação e aumentar a sustentabilidade da sua empresa, fortalecendo seu posicionamento no cenário competitivo.

O programa oferece bolsas para a inserção de doutores em empresas paranaenses , promovendo o desenvolvimento científico, tecnológico e de inovação. Os bolsistas atuarão diretamente na empresa, contribuindo com conhecimento de ponta e soluções personalizadas para o mercado , ancoradas na ciência e em evidências robustas.

Mais do que uma ponte entre academia e setor produtivo, o programa fomenta a aplicação prática do conhecimento científico , favorecendo a transformação de pesquisas em inovações reais, com alto impacto socioeconômico . A atuação dos doutores promove a cultura da ciência nas organizações, estimula a tomada de decisão baseada em dados e evidências , e potencializa a capacidade de resolver desafios complexos de forma criativa e sustentável .


Sobre a Oportunidade:


A história da Lopes se entrelaça com a trajetória de seus fundadores, João e Luzia. Em 1988, movidos pelo desejo de oferecer melhores condições de vida à família, iniciaram suas atividades no ramo da alimentação com um bar e restaurante. Desde então, o negócio sempre foi conduzido em família, passando também aos filhos do casal.

Em 1993, a Lopes deu início às atividades em Rebouças, já oferecendo serviços de padaria, confeitaria e lanchonete. Com o tempo, expandiu sua estrutura, agregando um restaurante moderno e aconchegante.

Com o propósito constante de servir em abundância, priorizando qualidade e higiene, João e Luzia dedicaram-se incansavelmente ao crescimento do empreendimento. Essa visão de futuro levou à necessidade de investir em gestão de processos e em uma cozinha industrial, pilares essenciais para sustentar o aumento da produção e a continuidade da expansão.


Formação Acadêmica:


Doutorado completo em Engenharia de Produção, Engenharia de Alimentos, Administração e áreas afins.

Defesa da tese há, no máximo, 5 anos.

Projeto: Mapeamento e Gestão por Processos


Principais Atividades:

  • Diagnósticos do cenário atual da empresa;
  • Mapeamento e gestão por processos;
  • Fluxograma;
  • Controles e registros de documentos produzidos na execução do projeto;
  • Atualização de documentos;
  • Conversa e convívio direto com os setores de produção.


Requisitos Técnicos Mínimos

  • Visão sistêmica e domínio em mapeamento e gestão por processos, fluxograma, controles e conhecimento de ferramentas práticas para transcrição e armazenamento desses processos;
  • Conhecimento em Lean e metodologias de gestão de processos;
  • Experiência profissional em áreas organizacionais e industriais com foco na produção de alimentos e gestão;
  • Experiência com mapeamento de processos.


Requisitos Técnicos Desejáveis / Diferenciais

  • Compreender a importância do projeto “Mapeamento e Gestão por Processo” para a empresa, garantindo engajamento e significado a todas as partes envolvidas;
  • Capacidade de tomar decisões baseado em dados, desenvolvendo ferramentas para avaliação de indicadores de desempenho e aplicando metodologias estruturadas;
  • Ter comportamento flexível e boa comunicação, atuando diretamente com líderes e setores e criando ambientes de troca sólidos e acessíveis para coleta de dados;
  • Atuar com rigor metodológico, organização e clareza na condução das etapas do projeto, cumprindo prazos e metas estipulados.

title: Líder Florestal - Patrimonial
description:
No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras.


As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose branqueada em Inocência (MS).


Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

description:
A Aegea

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.


Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.


A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.

  • Conduzir homologação de fornecedores e inspeções amostrais;
  • Elaborar procedimentos e diretrizes para processos de medição;
  • Atuar junto às áreas de Suprimentos, Unidades Operacionais e Fornecedores;
  • Suporte técnico à Diretoria e Unidades, com foco em eficiência e qualidade.

A Aegea é a empresa líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Trabalhamos por um futuro sustentável, colocando nossa paixão na prática fazendo a diferença nos +760 municípios em que atuamos. Empenhamos todos os esforços para contribuir com a sociedade por meio de inovações e serviços que vão além do tratamento e da distribuição de água e esgotamento sanitário. Nossa paixão é tornar cada dia melhor tanto o ambiente que oferecemos aos nossos colaboradores, bem como nos serviços que entregamos. Sobre a Vaga

A Vanzbon está expandindo no Brasil  e procura um Assistente de Operações e Administrativo . Esta é uma função prática e de execução , voltada para pessoas responsáveis e organizadas, que realizarão tarefas simples mas importantes do dia a dia: ir a órgãos públicos, consultar bancos, preparar e entregar documentos, além de apoiar a equipe de operações e compliance.

É uma posição nível júnior , ideal para quem tem pouca experiência e deseja aprender e crescer em uma empresa internacional.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Apoiar em pesquisas básicas sobre impostos e compliance  (ex.: políticas fiscais locais, ICMS/ISS, programas governamentais).
  • Preparar, copiar, digitalizar e protocolar documentos em órgãos públicos e fornecedores.
  • Auxiliar em agendamentos, arquivamento e organização de registros.
  • Acompanhar tarefas simples com contadores, cartórios ou consultores.
  • Entregar e recolher documentos quando necessário.
  • Apoiar a equipe com demandas administrativas e operacionais gerais.
Requisitos
  • Ensino médio completo ou algum curso superior já é suficiente.
  • Português fluente (obrigatório).
  • Inglês básico é um diferencial, mas não obrigatório.
  • 0–2 anos de experiência (auxiliar administrativo, office boy/runner, assistente ou similar).
  • Disponibilidade para ir pessoalmente a órgãos públicos e bancos.
  • Pessoa responsável, organizada, que aprende rápido e segue instruções.
O que Oferecemos
  • Salário compatível com cargo júnior.
  • Treinamento e acompanhamento da nossa equipe internacional.
  • Oportunidade de crescimento para funções mais avançadas no futuro.
  • Contato com serviços corporativos internacionais e negócios globais.

Como se Candidatar

Envie seu CV em português (ou inglês, se tiver) com uma breve apresentação para: 

 Saiba mais sobre a Vanzbon e siga nossas atualizações no LinkedIn:  Vanzbon LinkedIn Page



﻿ Position Overview

Vanzbon is expanding in Brazil  and we are looking for an Operations & Administrative Assistant . This is a hands-on role  for someone reliable and detail-oriented, responsible for simple but important daily tasks: visiting government offices, checking requirements at banks, preparing and submitting documents, and supporting our compliance and operations team.

This is a junior-level role , suitable for candidates with limited experience who want to learn and grow within an international company.


Key Responsibilities
  • Visit government departments  to ask about registration, licenses, subsidies, or incentives.
  • Visit banks  to inquire about corporate account opening policies and help identify new banking partners.
  • Support basic tax and compliance research  (e.g., local tax policies, VAT, available government programs).
  • Prepare, copy, scan, and submit company documents to authorities and service providers.
  • Assist with scheduling, filing, and maintaining records.
  • Coordinate with accountants, notaries, or consultants for simple follow-ups.
  • Deliver and collect documents as needed.
  • Provide general administrative and operational support to the team.
Requirements
  • High school diploma or some college education is sufficient.
  • Fluency in Portuguese (required).
  • Basic English is an advantage but not required.
  • 0–2 years of work experience (administrative, office assistant, runner, clerk, or similar).
  • Comfortable going to government offices and banks in person.
  • Reliable, detail-oriented, and willing to learn.
  • Strong sense of responsibility and ability to follow instructions carefully.
What We Offer
  • Entry-level salary appropriate for a junior role.
  • Training and guidance from our international operations team.
  • Opportunity to grow into more advanced roles over time.
  • Exposure to international corporate services and global business.

How to Apply

Send your CV in Portuguese (English version also welcome) with a short note about your interest to: 

 Learn more about Vanzbon and follow our updates on LinkedIn:  Vanzbon LinkedIn Page

title: Commercial Manager – Foreign Trade
description:
WE ARE ERO.

A mining company that was born in the heart of Brazil and has grown by bringing strength and energy to the world — driving key industries and contributing to the development of different regions.


Since 1979, when we started operations at the Caraíba site, we have consolidated our presence in the Brazilian mining sector. We expanded into the gold mine in Xavantina, advanced with the implementation of the Tucumã operation — set to become one of the main copper production hubs in the country — and continue to move forward with new projects such as the Furnas Project in Pará.


Our way of mining is guided by strong values: care, courage, honesty, collaboration, and excellence . These principles are at the center of everything we do — from daily operations to strategic decisions — and they also shape how we invest in the growth of every person at Ero.


Our goal is clear: to be the best mining company in Brazil . And we know this is only possible by investing in the people who build this future with us every day.


We are looking for a professional to join us as a Commercial Manager – Foreign Trade , responsible for planning, coordinating, and supervising the company's foreign trade operations, ensuring compliance with legal regulations, efficiency in import and export processes, and the maximization of commercial results in international markets. Ensures the achievement of goals within deadlines and quality standards defined by the company.


Location: São Paulo/SP

Employment Type: Full-time, CLT | Hybrid

Department: Finance Executive Office


✨ Grow with us!

#WeAreEro #CareersAtEro #Opportunity


Important: Ero does not charge any fees during the recruitment and selection process. All applications must be submitted exclusively through our official channels.



KEY RESPONSABILITIES:


•Develop import and export strategies aligned with the company’s objectives.

• Manage customs procedures, international documentation, and special trade regimes.

• Negotiate with suppliers, clients, and international agents.

• Monitor performance indicators and propose process improvements.

• Ensure compliance with national and international trade regulations

• Coordinate the team of foreign trade analysts and assistants.

• Collaborate with departments such as logistics, tax, procurement, and legal.

• Support and guide the preparation of the department’s budget.

• Use people management and integrated management tools to ensure team development and continuous process improvement.

• Develop and maintain appropriate relationships with clients, suppliers, the community, and public and private entities.



REQUIREMENTS


Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Foreign Trade, Business Administration, Sales, Engineering, or any field related to administration with a commercial profile.


Experience:

  • Commercial experience in commoditiies in mining sector, preferably copper and gold.
  • Experience leading multidisciplinary teams.
  • Experience in Foreign Trade (Import / Export processes), focusing bulk , break bulk vessels, project cargoes.
  • Experience in negotiating mining sales contracts.


Technical Knowledge:

  • Deep knowledge of Foreign Trade and negotiation, including:
  • Export matters in the countries we negotiate.
  • Import matters.
  • Negotiation – in different levels and different suppliers and different cultures.
  • Internal Logistics within Brazil (trucks, ports, airports, etc.).


Languages:

  • Fluency in English and Portuguese (Brazilian) is mandatory, both written and spoken.
  • Spanish – desirable , in communication.

title: Analista de Remuneração e Benefícios Sr.
description:
Sobre REDE SANTA CATARINA


Há 120 anos no Brasil, a Associação Congregação de Santa Catarina (ACSC) é responsável pela administração de 19 entidades com atuação social, em saúde e educação, que formam a Rede Santa Catarina. Com um modelo de gestão em que o superávit gerado é aplicado em nossas obras a fim de executar dignamente nossas atividades, a instituição acolhe e cuida do ser humano em todo o ciclo da vida. Ao todo são cerca de 10,5 mil colaboradores distribuídos em diversas instituições de saúde, mantendo inúmeros estabelecimentos de ensino e acolhendo crianças, adultos e idosos em espaços assistenciais, com atendimento humanizado e serviços de qualidade para milhares de pessoas em seis Estados brasileiros (Espírito Santo, Goiás, Minas Gerais, Rio de Janeiro, Santa Catarina e São Paulo).

MISSÃO: Acolher e cuidar do ser humano durante todo o ciclo da vida.

VISÃO: Ser referência de entidade filantrópica reconhecida pela sociedade, demonstrando amor às pessoas por meio de nossos atos.

VALORES: Preservação da vida, Humanização, Dignidade, Transparência e Sustentabilidade


Oportunidade:


Analista de Remuneração e Benefícios Sr.


Principais Responsabilidades


  • Desenvolver e atualizar estruturas de cargos e remuneração com base em metodologias como Korn Ferry/Hay .
  • Conduzir projetos complexos de revisão de estruturas organizacionais, remuneração fixa e variável, pacotes de benefícios e programas de incentivos (saúde e educação).
  • Ter experiencia em gestão de planos de saúde e acompanhamento com as operadoras, avaliando desempenho, custos e aderência às políticas internas.
  • Vivência em processos de M&A (Fusão e Aquisição) , avaliando impactos em estruturas, harmonização de remuneração e benefícios.
  • Elaborar trilhas de carreira e revisar organogramas, escopos de atuação e interdependências entre áreas.
  • Apoiar na condução do programa de remuneração variável.
  • Realizar análises de impacto financeiro das estratégias de remuneração e benefícios.
  • Desenvolver modelos preditivos para mensuração de impactos futuros.
  • Conectar estratégias de remuneração ao planejamento orçamentário da companhia.
  • Apoiar na construção do orçamento de remuneração e benefícios.
  • Criar e manter atualizadas as descrições de cargos.
  • Atuar na elaboração e implementação de políticas e diretrizes alinhadas às melhores práticas de mercado.


Requisitos Técnicos

title: Sales Training Facilitator (Brazilian Portuguese Speaker)
description:
RAIN Group, an award-winning global provider of innovative sales training and performance improvement services, is seeking contract sales training facilitators to add to our expanding team


This is a part-time, contract role.


Are you an independent sales training facilitator who is fluent in Brazilian Portuguese and English and is looking to align with a proven, time-tested sales methodology infused across a wide and deep portfolio of training offerings?


We are seeking dynamic individuals who are experts in training facilitation and who have experience delivering engaging learning in any of the following industries: technology, manufacturing, financial services, healthcare, or professional services.


Do you relish the opportunity to work with salespeople, sales managers and sales leaders to help them unleash their own sales potential and that of their organizations?


Do you thrive on delivering high-energy, high-impact, active learning experiences that make the participants the stars of the show?


This role is primarily responsible for crafting, delivering, and enabling our solutions in Brazil, with potential to work on select engagements in global settings. Your main focus will be to drive transformation and achieve results for learners and clients by delivering tailored content and RAIN Group IP through training, coaching, and reinforcement, utilizing a variety of delivery mediums.


Role Highlights:

You'll work within our client and product teams and be responsible for partnering directly with clients to execute the delivery of our programs so they achieve mutually agreed client results. This includes the tailoring of content, and the delivery and facilitation of sessions, coaching, and reinforcement.


You'll be expected to

· Drive client transformation and results by delivering world-class programming

· Project manage client engagements to ensure seamless execution, custom design, and details managed/produced on time and on budget

· Master IP knowledge, and be a source for others as an IP expert

· Meet expected KPI for client feedback on programming and facilitation

· Collaborate with internal teams on behalf of the client, accessing project management, development, content, technology to enable successful deliveries

· Maintain professional client and internal communication at the highest level

· Support sales or large-scale projects as needed

· Provide feedback to sales, product, marketing, and client results teams as needed


Desired Skills, Attributes, and Competencies:

Successful candidates are innately curious and creative thinkers with motivational energy who are comfortable working as part of a team. Training facilitators must have a sound understanding of adult learning theory and the use of experiential learning techniques.


Additional requirements include:

· Fluent in English and Brazilian Portuguese

· Minimum of a Bachelor’s degree

· Training facilitation experience and stellar references

· Demonstrated experience selling and/or leading sales teams

· Outstanding group facilitation and presentation skills

· Working knowledge of MS Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) and modern collaboration software

· Exceptional oral and written communication skills

· Knowledge of the instructional design process

· Ability to adapt and relate to all levels of leadership, management, and employees with ease and enthusiasm

· Ability to ramp up quickly on specific verticals and organizations

· Open to coaching and feedback

· Willingness to travel extensively domestically and open to international travel

· Reasonably convenient access to a major airport hub

· Availability and interest in training in the range of 2-10 days per month (exclusive of travel) depending upon demand


About Us

RAIN Group is a global sales training and consulting company that helps leading organizations improve sales results. Founded in 2002, we are experiencing significant growth and have established a reputation as a world-leader in sales training and consulting.


We take our company values seriously: Client Results, Excellence @ Speed, Openness, and Commitment to the Success of Others.

A SYSTRA é um dos principais grupos de engenharia e consultoria do mundo, especialista em transporte público e mobilidade sustentável. title: Cabotage Coordinator
description:
Cabotage Coordinator

Job Title: Cabotage Coordinator

Location: São Paulo, Brazil

Terms: Full Time. On site.

Compensation: Commensurate with experience, the individual’s, and the team’s performance.

Company:

Sky Fusion Global Supply Chain focus on global dry bulk shipping and Industrial Projects Logistics. Headquartered in Singapore, we have settled filiales in China, Morocco, South Africa, Australia, Brazil, USA, Germany, and continues to be a globally expanding group.


Our Core Business:

  • Global Dry Bulk Freight
  • Industrial Projects Logistics & Renewable Energy Supply Chain Innovation


For more information, you may check our website：


Role

Sky Fusion is seeking the right candidate to fill a key role, the new Cabotage Coordinator. The primary focus of this role is the coordination of bids for Brazilian Flag impelled cargo opportunities. These are cargoes that will move within the Brazilian territory.

The coordinator will be tasked with evaluating and pursuing both commercial and operational cargoes for carriage on the Company’s Brazil Flag vessels. The scope of these cargo bids may often require extension of the scope to include use of multimodal forms of conveyance.

Candidates are encouraged to think outside of the box. There are always new challenges on the horizon and ways to improve, even in a business as old as shipping.

This position will challenge the coordinator to come up with creative solutions by matching multiple fleet schedules and modes of transportation with various bids. This role will require constant interaction and communication with the Client’s team to ensure the successful execution of projects.


Responsibilities & Duties

a. Identification and pursuit of chartering opportunities for wind projects.

b. Voyage calculations and pricing of both near‐term and long‐term project cargoes.

c. Analysis of intermodal bids (commercial).

d. Administration of quoting system. Emphasis on visibility within team and timely communications with

customers.

e. Project monitoring

f. Tracking Wind Cargo Flows (Historic & Projected)


Requirements & Skills

a. Ability to multi‐task

b. Understanding of terms and conditions for contracts of carriage and carriage of breakbulk cargoes under Brazilian Cabotage legistlation.

c. Strong verbal and written communication skills

d. Attention to detail.

e. Minimum of bachelor’s degree (preferably in a Maritime Business Administration or Transportation).

f. Minimum three (3) years of experience in the Fluvial / Caoastal cabotage transportation industry is preferred but candidates with les experience will still receive consideration.


Personal Characteristics

Ambitious | Enthusiastic | Team player

title: Analista de Negócios Digitais
description:
Estamos contratando um(a) Analista de Produtos Digitais para atuar diretamente em um de nossos clientes. Você será a ponte estratégica entre negócio e tecnologia, ajudando a descobrir, desenhar e evoluir soluções digitais de ponta a ponta. Você irá mapear processos, levantar requisitos, prototipar MVPs e orquestrar integrações, acelerando a entrega de valor através de uma abordagem baseada em dados e hipóteses validadas.


Responsabilidades:

  • Discovery e estratégia: conduzir entrevistas, mapear “as-is/to-be”, identificar dores e oportunidades, definir escopo, resultados desejados e critérios de sucesso;
  • Especificação de produto: traduzir necessidades em histórias, fluxos e critérios de aceite, garantindo alinhamento com engenharia e demais stakeholders;
  • Prototipação rápida (hands-on): criar PoCs/MVPs com Lovable e validar com usuários-chave;
  • Automação e integrações: orquestrar fluxos e APIs com n8n (workflows visuais, agentes/LLMs, transformações de dados) e registrar decisões;
  • Validação contínua: estruturar experimentos (smoke tests/MVP), instrumentar medições e consolidar aprendizados para os próximos incrementos ou rodadas de desenvolvimento.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência como Analista de Negócios/Produto em iniciativas digitais (B2B/B2C), com forte capacidade analítica e de facilitação;
  • Mão na massa em prototipação: vivência com Lovable (ou plataforma similar) para criar protótipos funcionais;
  • Automação/orquestração: experiência com n8n (ou equivalente) integrando serviços e montando workflows com APIs;
  • Noções sólidas de APIs REST (design, versionamento, segurança) e documentação clara;
  • Prática com discovery contínuo, testes de hipóteses e rastreabilidade de decisões.


Diferenciais que somam (não eliminatórios):

  • Cases de MVPs lançados rapidamente (Lovable + integrações) e migração de processos legados para arquitetura orientada a APIs.
  • Vivência com governança e riscos em transformação digital.


Informações adicionais:

  • Formato: PJ
  • Local: Remoto (base em São Paulo/SP)
  • Senioridade: Junio a Pleno
  • Início: a combinar

title: Gerente Sr. em Relações Sindicais
description:
Somos PepsiCo


Junte-se à PepsiCo e Ouse Transformar! Somos o lugar perfeito para pessoas curiosas, pensadoras e agentes de mudança. Desde o frontline até a nossa liderança, estamos entusiasmados(as) com o futuro e trabalhamos em equipe para tornar o mundo um lugar melhor.


Fazer parte da PepsiCo significa fazer parte de uma das maiores empresas de alimentos e bebidas do mundo, com nossas marcas icônicas sendo consumidas mais de um bilhão de vezes por dia em mais de 200 países. No Brasil desde 1953, a PepsiCo possui marcas reconhecidas como QUAKER®, TODDY®, TODDYNHO®, ELMA CHIPS®, RUFFLES®, DORITOS®, EQLIBRI ™, GATORADE®, KERO COCO®, H2OH!®, PEPSI® e muitas outras.

Conheça um pouco mais sobre a PepsiCo: PepsiCoJobs


A Oportunidade


O Gerente Sr. de Relações Sindicais desempenha um papel crucial na definição e execução da estratégia de relações sindicais da PepsiCo do Brasil Foods. Esse cargo é responsável por desenvolver uma estrutura abrangente que esteja alinhada aos objetivos operacionais e à força de trabalho da PepsiCo do Brasil Foods, garantindo uma abordagem proativa e estratégica em relações sindicais. Atuando como principal negociador em negociações coletivas e interações com Conselhos de Trabalho, Sindicatos e representantes dos empregados, o Diretor de Relações Trabalhistas representa os interesses da PBF enquanto promove relações produtivas e positivas.


Sindicatos e empregados sindicalizados:Gerenciar relações com aprox. 80 sindicatos e conduzir mais de 330 negociações, representando 100% dos empregados sindicalizados, de forma a gerenciar eficazmente os processos de negociação coletiva. Melhorar as relações com o Ministério do Trabalho e outras autoridades.


Seu impacto


Negociação com sindicatos de Vendedores, Comércio, Motoristas e Operações (~150/ano);

Elaboração de relatórios gerenciais relacionados a todas as negociações coletivas;

Relacionamento com o Ministério do Trabalho e com os principais líderes sindicais, a fim de garantir negociações coletivas eficazes.


Quem estamos buscando?


  • Ensino Superior completa em Direito, Administração ou áreas correlatas.
  • Sólida vivência com relações sindicais e negociações.
  • Inglês/espanhol - diferencial
  • Excelente habilidade analítica e organizacional, incluindo definição de prioridades e tomada de decisões;
  • Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita.
  • Capacidade de iniciativa e de priorizar a carga de trabalho, sendo capaz de entregar resultados sob pressão e dentro de prazos definidos;
  • Trabalho em equipe, com habilidade para liderar e influenciar.


Se esta oportunidade for do seu interesse, incentivamos que se candidate, mesmo que não atenda 100% dos requisitos.


O que você pode esperar da gente?


Na PepsiCo, queremos recompensar da melhor forma o seu desempenho e trabalho, cuidando sempre do seu bem-estar integral. Por isso, oferecemos:

  • Remuneração competitiva, com componentes fixos e variáveis que permitirão alcançar suas metas financeiras.
  • Um programa de flexibilidade que permitirá equilibrar melhor sua vida pessoal e profissional, adaptando seu horário de trabalho ao seu estilo de vida.
  • Benefícios como seguros, telemedicina e check-up médico, para que você se mantenha sempre em seu melhor estado de saúde.
  • Com nosso benefício de Auto Executivo, você poderá escolher entre um carro, que inclui também ajuda com combustível e manutenção; ou um bônus de auxílio transporte (apenas para níveis gerenciais L10+).
  • Um programa de bem, com diferentes iniciativas ao longo do ano, que ajudará a promover mais equilíbri o para a sua saúde física, mental e integral -.
  • Programas que ajudarão a cuidar do seu bem-estar financeiro e a alcançar suas metas em todas as etapas da sua vida: Programa de Bem-Estar Financeiro, Caixa de Poupança, Fundo de Poupança e Previdência Privada.
  • Adoramos celebrar o sucesso, por isso contamos com programas de reconhecimento por tempo de trabalho, comportamentos, liderança, momentos de vida, entre outros.
  • E como sua família também é importante para nós, estendemos benefícios como nossa Linha de Bem-Estar, Convênios e Descontos, programas de Bolsas de Estudo para seus/suas filhos(as), Planos de Auxílios para diferentes momentos de vida, entre outros.


Na PepsiCo, estamos comprometidos em promover uma equipe de trabalho diversa, criando um espaço colaborativo, equitativo e inclusivo, onde todas as pessoas - independentemente de como nos parecemos, de onde viemos ou a quem amamos - tenham suas vozes ouvidas. Oferecemos igualdade de oportunidades e consideramos os(as) candidatos(as) para todos os cargos, sem distinção de gênero, raça, orientação sexual, religião, nacionalidade, idade ou deficiência.

Diferenciais:

  • Familiaridade com conceitos de estatística: amostragem, níveis de significância, correlação, entre outros cálculos.

Informações adicionais:

Acreditamos que a verdadeira transformação só acontece quando diferentes histórias, olhares e trajetórias se encontram. Por isso, valorizamos e promovemos um ambiente diverso, seguro e inclusivo, onde todas as pessoas possam ser quem são — com autonomia, respeito e pertencimento.

title: Full Stack Developer - Senior
description:
A agência 270B está procurando um web developer para se juntar à nossa equipe, e nos ajudar a criar ótimas experiências digitais para todo nosso grupo de clientes. Esta é uma posição para quem ama o que faz, para quem é curioso e interessado pelo mundo digital, e que está sempre procurando uma maneira melhor e mais inovadora de desenvolver os projetos.


Procuramos candidatos com capacidade comprovada de dar vida a ideias criativas por meio de códigos, que possua 7 a 10 anos de experiência (de preferência em uma agência ou estúdio).

A 270B opera em um modelo híbrido que inclui experiências de trabalho no escritório e remoto.


Perfil da vaga:

•     Perfil atualizado: acompanha as últimas tendências em tecnologia, interfaces de usuário e desenvolvimento web.

•     Bom relacionamento interpessoal para trabalhar em equipe: você entrega o seu trabalho com qualidade ao trabalhar com uma equipe multidisciplinar, especialmente para dar vida a grandes projetos.

•     Fluência em inglês, com comunicação 100% clara no idioma: você pode transmitir suas ideias de forma clara (tanto escrita quanto falada), especialmente para os colaboradores que não possuem conhecimentos técnicos.

•     Perfil interessado em crescer, que está sempre aprendendo algo novo: procura oportunidades e é aberto para feedbacks.

•     Perfil flexível: você pode lidar com a ambiguidade, pode aprender coisas novas para entregar em um projeto. Você lida bem com mudanças de escopo, prazos e metas.

•     Perfil solucionador de problemas: você gosta de encontrar soluções sustentáveis para problemas do mundo real que ajudem empresas e organizações a atingir seus objetivos. Você está focado em atingir o resultado.

Como funcionará o dia a dia?

Ao desenvolver novos projetos, você trabalhará com arquivos Adobe XD, CMSs headless, JavaScript ou TypeScript e sites estáticos. Utilizar as mais recentes tecnologias e práticas da indústria nos permite agir com rapidez e eficiência. Além de codificar sites, você também fará parte das etapas de planejamento e resolução de problemas de novos projetos – interface com membros da equipe interna e partes interessadas do cliente. Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com designers e avaliar novas práticas é uma parte essencial dessa função. Você também será responsável por contratar, integrar e trabalhar com desenvolvedores contratados ou equipes de desenvolvimento para organizar projetos maiores.

Você também apoiará projetos mais antigos usando tecnologias ultrapassadas. Você trabalhará com projetos WordPress usando tecnologias como Sass, Gulp e jQuery. Para isto, as habilidades de solução de problemas e aprendizado em tempo real serão importantes.

Pré Requisitos

•          HTML5

•          CSS3/CSS Preprocessors

•          JavaScript/ES6

•          JS Frameworks (React, Angular, Vue, etc.)

•          Responsive Web Design

•          QA experiencia, detalista,

•          Package Managers (npm, yarn)

•          Experiencia com compatibilidade cross-browser

Será responsável por coordenar um analista sênior, interagir constantemente com a área de negócios e desenvolver controles, processos e indicadores para dar suporte a uma operação complexa que envolve importação, estoque e vendas no mercado nacional, bem como operações de exportação de minérios de aço e manganês.


Principais responsabilidades:

  • Gestão da equipe: liderar e desenvolver um analista sênior, garantindo entrega de análises consistentes e dentro dos prazos;

  • Gestão de estoques: controlar o aging, volumes, custos médios e variações, além de realizar marcação a mercado e análises de giro e rentabilidade por produto;

  • Interação com áreas de negócio: atuar como parceiro da operação de aço, garantindo alinhamento com a equipe comercial e logística quanto a margens, custos e riscos;
  • Projetos e melhorias: implementar novos controles e processos em conjunto com a controladoria corporativa, promovendo maior robustez e agilidade na gestão;


Requisitos necessários para essa função:

  • Superior Completo em Administração, Economia, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas; pós-graduação/MBA será um diferencial;
  • Inglês fluente;
  • Conhecimento sólido em operações de comércio exterior e em mercado financeiro/cambial (exposição, NDFs, hedge);
  • Forte domínio de ferramentas de análise de dados: Excel avançado, Power BI e Power Query; conhecimento em SQL é diferencial;

Assistência Médica e Odontológica;

title: Events Specialist
description:
ABOUT SHEIN

SHEIN is a global online fashion and lifestyle retailer, offering SHEIN branded apparel and products from global network of vendors, all at affordable prices. Headquartered in Singapore, SHEIN remains committed to making the beauty of fashion accessible to all, promoting its industry-leading, on demand production methodology, for a smarter, future-ready industry. Founded in 2012, SHEIN has more than 16,000 employees operating from offices around the world, and continues to expand operations globally. Join SHEIN and be the future!


ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking a dynamic and results-oriented Events Specialist to spearhead our presence and engagement initiatives within the local market. This role is crucial in building and nurturing strong relationships with key organizations, particularly shopping malls and local businesses, to drive brand visibility, foster community ties, and support our strategic objectives, including the growth of the SHEIN Marketplace. The ideal candidate will be an exceptional communicator, a meticulous planner, and a proactive relationship builder with a proven track record in event management and stakeholder engagement.


Key Responsibilities:

Strategic Relationship Management:

  • Develop and maintain strong, collaborative relationships with key external organizations, including shopping malls, local businesses, industry associations, and community groups.
  • Identify and cultivate new partnership opportunities that align with SHEIN's regional goals and brand values.
  • Act as the primary point of contact and ambassador for SHEIN in regional interactions, ensuring consistent brand messaging and positive representation.

Event Planning & Execution:

  • Design, plan, and execute a diverse portfolio of regional events, activations, and promotional projects, often in collaboration with other partners.
  • Oversee all logistical aspects of events, including venue selection, vendor coordination, staffing, permits, and materials.
  • Ensure all events are meticulously organized, on-brand, and deliver an exceptional experience for attendees and partners.

Budget Management & Optimization:

  • Develop, manage, and meticulously track budgets for all events and partnership initiatives, ensuring cost-effectiveness and adherence to financial guidelines.
  • Negotiate contracts with vendors and partners to secure favorable terms and maximize ROI.
  • Provide regular financial reporting and analysis on event expenditures.

Regional Representation & Communication:

  • Represent SHEIN at regional industry events, meetings, and community gatherings, networking effectively to enhance brand perception and uncover new opportunities.
  • Develop and deliver compelling presentations about SHEIN's initiatives (e.g., Marketplace, new campaigns) to various external stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with internal marketing and communications teams to ensure consistent messaging and promotion of regional activities.

Project Management:

  • Lead and manage complex projects involving multiple internal and external stakeholders, such as setting up stands, events, or joint marketing campaigns with shopping malls / industry associations.
  • Develop detailed project plans, timelines, and deliverables, ensuring projects are completed on time and within scope.
  • Proactively identify and mitigate risks, and implement solutions to challenges that arise during planning or execution.

Reporting & Analysis:

  • Track and analyze key performance indicators (KPIs) for all events and partnerships, providing comprehensive post-event reports and insights.
  • Utilize data to evaluate the success of initiatives and inform future strategy development.

Local Travel:

  • Frequent local travel within the designated region will be required to attend meetings and oversee event execution.


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business Administration, Event Management, Public Relations, or a related field.
  • 5 years of proven experience in event management, community relations, and/or partnership development, preferably within retail, e-commerce, or a fast-paced environment.
  • Demonstrated experience in managing budgets, negotiating contracts, and optimizing resources for events.
  • Strong track record of building and nurturing successful relationships with diverse organizations and stakeholders.
  • Excellent project management skills with the ability to manage multiple initiatives concurrently, from conception to completion.
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with proven ability to deliver engaging presentations.
  • Proactive, results-oriented, and highly organized with meticulous attention to detail.
  • Ability to work independently, make sound decisions, and adapt to a dynamic work environment.
  • Fluency in Portuguese and Mandarim is mandatory.
  • Fluency in English is a plus.
  • Willingness and ability to travel locally as required.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in the e-commerce or fashion retail industry.
  • Familiarity with the regional market landscape, including key shopping centers and local organizations.
  • Experience presenting to large groups or external partners.


At SHEIN, we believe that diversity is the force that drives innovation. We are committed to creating an environment where all voices are heard, valued and respected. All our vacancies are inclusive for people with disabilities, women, black people, LGBTQIAPN+ community and all types of diversity.

title: Geotechnical Engineer
description:
We are seeking a skilled Geotechnical Engineer to lead quality assurance, compliance, and inspection efforts for civil infrastructure projects on Diego Garcia . This hands-on role focuses on geotechnical engineering practices—earthwork, excavation, backfilling, pavement construction, and utility installation—ensuring strict adherence to US standards (USACE, EM 385-1-1), contractual obligations, and international codes (ISO, BS, EU). The Engineer will oversee testing, design, and maintenance of geotechnical elements in roads, bridges, and buildings.


Roles & Responsibilities

  • Develop and implement Project-Specific Quality Control Plans (QCP) in compliance with contract specifications, US Standards, and applicable international standards (e.g., ISO, USACE, EM 385-1-1), with a strong focus on geotechnical elements such as earthwork, excavation, filling and backfilling, pavement construction, and utility installation.
  • Review design documents, technical specifications, and project plans to identify quality requirements, using computer-aided design (CAD) software and engineering principles to ensure civil/geotechnical infrastructure (e.g., roads, bridges, buildings) meets US Standards.
  • Perform daily inspections and surveillance of construction activities, including geotechnical assessments for earthwork, excavation, filling and backfilling, pavement construction, utility installation, concrete/steel testing, and site stability evaluations, to ensure compliance with approved plans, procedures, and project specifications.
  • Lead and Support the Three-Phase Control Process (Preparatory, Initial, and Follow-Up) and document all phases of work, with an emphasis on geotechnical risks, mitigations, and responsible charge oversight for earthwork and related activities.
  • Manage Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs), implement corrective/preventive actions, and track resolution for issues related to geotechnical engineering, including excavation stability, backfilling compaction, pavement integrity, and utility installation.
  • Coordinate and supervise third-party testing laboratories, ensuring timely submittal and approval of test results for geotechnical materials (e.g., soil, aggregates) to BS, EU, and US Standards.
  • Oversee quality aspects of the construction, maintenance, and repair of civil infrastructure projects on Diego Garcia, with responsible charge for geotechnical components such as earthwork, excavation, filling and backfilling, pavement construction, and utility installation, ensuring all work is performed in accordance with construction plans, specifications, and safety protocols.
  • Train and guide site personnel on quality standards, inspection protocols, documentation requirements, and geotechnical best practices, including safe handling of earthwork and utility-related tasks.
  • Maintain detailed QC documentation, including daily reports, inspection checklists, material submittals, test records, and CAD-generated plans for geotechnical-focused projects.
  • Interface with the client, project management, subcontractors, regulatory agencies, engineers, architects, and contractors on quality and geotechnical issues, providing technical support in a responsible charge role to ensure successful project completion.
  • Monitor the effectiveness of the quality system, recommend process improvements, and conduct/participate in internal audits while facilitating external quality audits as required.
  • Inspect civil infrastructure projects to ensure ongoing compliance with US Standards, project specifications, security, and safety procedures, including work in extreme weather conditions, with a focus on geotechnical stability and performance.


Qualifications & Requirements :

  • Bachelor’s degree in civil engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Licensed and registered as a Civil Engineer or Geotechnical Engineer in the United States of America (e.g., Professional Engineer (PE) certification).
  • At least 5 years of licensed experience, of which at least 3 years must be in responsible charge in geotechnical engineering practice or the type of work being performed on this project (e.g., earthwork, excavation, filling and backfilling, pavement construction, and utility installation).
  • QC certification for relevant industries (e.g., geotechnical testing).
  • Significant material testing expertise to BS, EU, and US Standards.
  • Knowledge of US construction standards and codes (e.g., USACE, CQC).
  • Experience with government contracting, security, and safety procedures.
  • Hands-on experience in External & Internal Quality Audit Programmes, ISO Quality Management System, and quality tools/methodologies.

title: Cloud Data Engineer
description:
JOB SUMMARY

Responsible for designing and implementing robust data pipelines. Must maintain high data quality and security in cloud environments, automating tasks with Python and Bash scripting, and continuously research new technologies to enhance scalability. This role focuses on the development and implementation of data engineering solutions that enhance data warehousing capabilities and maintain legacy and new systems.


DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Design and implement data pipelines to move and transform data from various sources into cloud-based data warehouses.
  • Develop and maintain ETL processes using tools such as Fivetran, Matillion, SSIS, SSAS, SSRSand Snowflake Dataflow on AWS.
  • Optimize data storage and retrieval by designing and implementing data partitioning, indexing, and compression strategies.
  • Build and maintain data processing infrastructure on cloud platforms such as AWS.
  • Collaborate with business and analysts to ensure data quality, accuracy, and availability for analysis and reporting.
  • Manage and lead Complex System Design, Integration and Development.
  • Monitor and troubleshoot data pipelines and infrastructure to ensure high availability and performance.
  • Implement security and access controls to protect sensitive data in cloud-based environments.
  • Automate data processing tasks using scripting languages such as Python or Bash
  • Research and evaluate new technologies and tools to improve data processing efficiency and scalability.
  • Mentor and train junior data engineers and provide technical guidance to cross-functional teams.
  • Perform other job-related functions as assigned.



QUALIFICATIONS

DEGREE TYPE:

Bachelor's Degree

FIELD(S) OF STUDY:

Computer Science, Engineering or related field


EXPERIENCE

  • Minimum of 4 years’ experience developing, validating, and implementing data warehouses, data systems or cloud-based data solutions.
  • Experience in data engineering with a focus on data warehousing and legacy systems.
  • Experience with multiple data modeling approaches, SQL, and scripting programming languages like Python and PowerShell.


COMPETENCIES/SKILLS

  • Good understanding of OLAP Cubes, Dimensional model.
  • Ability to lead and coach team members.
  • Strong communication skills and stakeholder engagement abilities; driving results through innovation, process improvement and creativity.
  • Able to prioritize and execute tasks in a high-pressure, fast-paced environment.
  • Demonstrated understanding of agile methodologies, QA practices and user experience, with strong digital & technical skills.
  • Experienced with collaboration tools (Jira, Confluence, Lucid Chart;).
  • Strong understanding of databases such as Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle, MySQL, HANA, Snowflake.
  • Experience with traditional on-prem virtual and physical infrastructure, as well as cloud-based environments, preferably AWS.
  • Excellent understanding of Windows, and Linux based infrastructure.
  • Working knowledge of various tools, open-source technologies, and cloud services

description:
Role Overview:


We are seeking a dynamic and strategic PR Specialist to lead public relations for our smartphone brand. The ideal candidate will be responsible for shaping our brand narrative, strengthening media relations, driving product launch coverage, and managing crisis communications. This role requires a strong network with tech and lifestyle media, excellent communication skills, and the ability to deliver impactful stories that position our brand as an industry leader.


Key Responsibilities:


Public Relations & Media:

  • Develop and execute PR strategies that enhance brand visibility and credibility in the smartphone industry.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with top-tier tech, lifestyle, and business media outlets.
  • Draft, review, and distribute press releases, media kits, Q&As, and product-related communications.
  • Secure proactive media coverage across online, print, broadcast, and influencer platforms.


Product Launch Support:

  • Lead PR campaigns for new smartphone launches, from pre-launch buzz to post-launch media engagement.
  • Organize and manage press conferences, launch events, and media briefings.
  • Collaborate with product and marketing teams to craft compelling product stories.


Corporate & Crisis Communication:

  • Act as spokesperson when required; prepare executives for media interviews.
  • Monitor public sentiment and manage crisis communications with timely responses.
  • Ensure consistent alignment with global brand messaging and corporate communication guidelines.


Content & Storytelling:

  • Create thought leadership content, media pitches, and brand stories highlighting innovation, technology, and lifestyle value.
  • Collaborate with social media and digital teams to extend PR campaigns online.


Measurement & Reporting:

  • Track, analyze, and report PR performance metrics (media coverage, SOV, sentiment, reach, etc.).
  • Provide insights and recommendations for improving PR effectiveness.


Qualifications & Skills:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Journalism, Marketing, or related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in PR, preferably in consumer electronics, smartphones, or technology sector.
  • Strong media network across tech, lifestyle, and business press.
  • Exceptional writing, editing, and storytelling skills in (insert relevant languages).
  • Experience managing product launch PR campaigns end-to-end.
  • Skilled in crisis communication and reputation management.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, global brand environment.
  • Proficiency in PR monitoring and analytics tools.


Nice-to-Have:

  • Experience working with influencers and KOLs in the tech/lifestyle space.
  • Previous experience in managing agency partners and event PR.
  • Familiarity with mobile technology trends and consumer behavior in emerging markets

title: Infrastructure Project Manager (Data Center Migration & Network Support)
description:
Infrastructure Project Manager (Data Center Migration & Network Support)

Brazil

Duration: 1 Year + Possibility of extension

Full time - Onsite


Job Description


We're seeking an organized, proactive coordinator to support a co-managed data center migration from on-premises to the comanaged location. This role will partner with global teams, vendors, and internal stakeholders to plan, track, and execute migration activities, while also supporting ongoing infrastructure and network operations. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, an excellent communicator, and experienced in coordinating complex infrastructure projects across time zones.


  • Key Responsibilities Project coordination for data center migration:
  • Assist in developing and maintaining the migration project plan, timelines, milestones, and dependencies.
  • Coordinate discovery and inventory of applications, servers, storage, network devices, and interdependencies.
  • Support readiness assessments, migration runbooks, fallback plans, and post-migration validation.
  • Track risks, assumptions, issues, and dependencies (RAID), and drive mitigation or escalation.
  • Schedule and facilitate migration waves, change windows, and cutover activities with cross-functional teams.
  • Maintain clear documentation, status reports, and decision logs.
  • Global stakeholder engagement:
  • Serve as a central point of contact across global infrastructure, network, security, application, and operations teams.
  • Coordinate with the co-managed data center provider at the comanaged location and relevant third-party vendors.
  • Organize and lead recurring standups, working sessions, and steering updates; capture and distribute minutes and action items.
  • Escalate blockers to the appropriate leadership and functional teams with context and recommended next steps.
  • Infrastructure and network support:
  • Support day-to-day infrastructure and network-related activities tied to the migration (e.g., change coordination, maintenance scheduling, access requests).
  • Coordinate network changes, including VLANs, routing updates, firewall rule requests, WAN/Internet transitions, and load balancer configurations as directed by SMEs.
  • Help track capacity planning inputs (compute, storage, network bandwidth) and ensure alignment with target-state designs.
  • Assist in validating connectivity, performance baselines, and post-migration health checks with monitoring teams.
  • Governance, compliance, and change management:
  • Ensure changes follow change control processes, maintenance windows, and communication protocols.
  • Coordinate audit-ready documentation for migrations, including approvals, test results, and backout plans.
  • Partner with security and compliance teams on control requirements, access provisioning, and data handling policies.
  • Cutover and hypercare support:
  • Coordinate pre-cutover checkpoints, go/no-go decisions, and stakeholder communications.
  • Track hypercare issues, triage to the right teams, and ensure timely resolution and handoff to steady-state operations.
  • Capture lessons learned and contribute to playbooks for subsequent migration waves.

Communication and reporting:

  • Maintain dashboards, trackers, and concise status updates for technical teams and leadership.
  • Provide clear escalation paths, SLAs/ETAs, and communication cadences across time zones.
  • Keep project artifacts current in the designated PM and documentation tools.
  • Vendor and contract coordination:
  • Liaise with co-location and managed service providers for circuit turn-ups, cross-connects, racking/stacking schedules, remote hands, and logistics.
  • Track vendor deliverables and dependencies; escalate variances proactively.
  • Logistics and asset coordination:
  • Support shipment, receiving, and chain-of-custody processes for hardware moves.
  • Coordinate decommissioning, data sanitization workflows, and disposal certificates for retired assets.
  • Quality and risk management:
  • Assist with test plans for application and infrastructure validation (connectivity, performance, failover).
  • Monitor risk indicators (timeline slippage, capacity shortfalls, change collisions) and raise timely alerts.


  • Preferred Qualifications Experience coordinating data center or large-scale infrastructure migrations in a co-managed or hybrid environment.
  • Familiarity with core infrastructure concepts: servers/virtualization, storage, networking (routing, switching, firewalls, load balancers), DNS, and monitoring.
  • Hands-on experience with project coordination tools (e.g., Jira, Azure DevOps, ServiceNow, Smartsheet, or similar).
  • Strong meeting facilitation, documentation, and stakeholder communication skills across technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Ability to work across global time zones and manage competing priorities.


Nice to Have:

  • Exposure to disaster recovery planning, backup/restore coordination, and business continuity exercises.
  • Understanding of change management frameworks and ITIL concepts.
  • Experience with inventory discovery tools and CMDB hygiene efforts.

Success Indicators:

  • On-time delivery of migration milestones with minimal incidents.
  • Clear, consistent communication and timely escalation of risks/issues.
  • Accurate, audit-ready documentation and repeatable runbooks for each migration wave.
  • Smooth handoffs from project to operations and measurable reduction in post-migration issues.

title: Platform Engineer
description:
About Trace Finance

Trace Finance empowers global payment enterprises to seamlessly move money across borders and access stablecoins with ease. With over $5 billion USD in processed volume, we provide the infrastructure that enables instant settlement, regulatory clarity, and best-in-class FX and crypto on/off ramps. We're building the future of cross-border payments and digital asset infrastructure.

The Role

We're seeking a talented mid-level Platform Engineer (DevOps Engineer) to join our infrastructure team. While we prefer candidates who can work from our office for better collaboration and team integration, we also offer remote work flexibility. You'll be instrumental in building and maintaining the cloud infrastructure and automation systems that power our global payment platform. This is an opportunity to work on mission-critical infrastructure that supports billions in transaction volume and ensures 24/7 availability for our financial services.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design, implement, and maintain scalable cloud infrastructure on AWS to support high-volume financial transactions
  • Build and manage CI/CD pipelines to enable rapid, reliable software deployments
  • Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code using Terraform for consistent, reproducible environments
  • Deploy, configure, and optimize Kubernetes clusters for containerized workloads
  • Implement comprehensive monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions to ensure system reliability
  • Automate operational tasks and improve deployment processes to increase team efficiency
  • Collaborate with development teams to optimize application performance and reliability
  • Ensure security best practices across all infrastructure components
  • Participate in on-call rotation to maintain 24/7 system availability
  • Document infrastructure architecture, runbooks, and operational procedures
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex infrastructure issues in production environments
Requirements
  • 3-5 years of experience in Platform Engineering, DevOps, or Site Reliability Engineering roles
  • Strong problem-solving skills and systematic approach to troubleshooting
  • Ability to work independently whether in office or remote settings
  • Passion for automation, reliability, and operational excellence
  • Interest in financial technology and innovation
  • PJ (Pessoa Jurídica) registration or willingness to obtain
Required Technical Skills
  • Cloud Platforms: Strong hands-on experience with AWS services (EC2, ECS/EKS, RDS, S3, VPC, IAM, CloudWatch, etc.)
  • Container Orchestration: Proven expertise with Kubernetes (deployment, scaling, troubleshooting)
  • Infrastructure as Code: Proficiency with Terraform for managing cloud resources
  • CI/CD: Experience building and maintaining pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, or similar)
  • Scripting: Strong scripting skills in Bash, Python, or similar languages
  • Containerization: Solid understanding of Docker and container best practices
  • Networking: Understanding of networking concepts, load balancers, DNS, and security groups
  • Monitoring & Observability: Experience with tools like Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack, or CloudWatch
  • Version Control: Proficiency with Git and collaborative development workflows
  • Basic English proficiency (required for documentation and team communication)
Nice-to-Have Technical Skills
  • Experience with microservices architecture and service mesh (Istio, Linkerd)
  • Database administration experience (MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Redis)
  • Message queue systems (AWS SNS, SQS, Kafka)
  • Security and compliance tools (Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, security scanning)
  • Experience with financial systems and high-availability requirements
  • Advanced Kubernetes features (operators, custom resources, Helm)
  • GitOps practices and tools (ArgoCD, Flux)
  • Performance tuning and capacity planning
  • Cost optimization strategies for cloud infrastructure
  • Intermediate English proficiency
Essential Soft Skills
  • Proactive mindset - Identify potential issues before they become problems
  • Self-learner - Stay current with evolving DevOps tools and practices
  • Critical thinking - Analyze complex systems and design elegant solutions
  • Self-management - Prioritize work effectively and manage your time independently
  • Team collaboration - Work effectively with engineering teams across different time zones
  • Commitment - Dedicated to maintaining system reliability and meeting SLAs
  • Versatility - Adapt to new technologies and changing infrastructure needs
  • Communication - Clearly document and explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences
What We Offer
  • Flexible work arrangement (office preferred, remote possible)
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge fintech and blockchain infrastructure
  • Build and maintain systems that process billions in transaction volume
  • Collaborative, innovative team environment with strong engineering culture
  • Professional growth opportunities in cloud technologies and DevOps practices
  • Exposure to both traditional finance and cryptocurrency ecosystems
  • Impact the reliability and scalability of global payment infrastructure
  • Work with modern tools and technologies in a forward-thinking organization


Ready to build world-class infrastructure? Join us at Trace Finance and be part of the team that powers the future of cross-border transactions and digital assets.

title: Financial Controller - LATAM
description:
Our Mission
At Palo Alto Networks® everything starts and ends with our mission:
Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.
Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.
Who We Are
We take our mission of protecting the digital way of life seriously. We are relentless in protecting our customers and we believe that the unique ideas of every member of our team contributes to our collective success. Our values were crowdsourced by employees and are brought to life through each of us everyday - from disruptive innovation and collaboration, to execution. From showing up for each other with integrity to creating an environment where we all feel included.
As a member of our team, you will be shaping the future of cybersecurity. We work fast, value ongoing learning, and we respect each employee as a unique individual. Knowing we all have different needs, our development and personal wellbeing programs are designed to give you choice in how you are supported. This includes our FLEXBenefits wellbeing spending account with over 1,000 eligible items selected by employees, our mental and financial health resources, and our personalized learning opportunities - just to name a few!
At Palo Alto Networks, we believe in the power of collaboration and value in-person interactions. This is why our employees generally work full time from our office with flexibility offered where needed. This setup fosters casual conversations, problem-solving, and trusted relationships. Our goal is to create an environment where we all win with precision.
Job Description
Your Career
Palo Alto Networks has an exciting opportunity for a LatAm Controller to join our Finance Team. We are looking for a financial professional interested in a senior level opportunity as a regional Controller to ensure accuracy and completeness of accounting and financial reporting for the Palo Alto Networks legal entities in the Latin American region and play a key role in re-engineering processes to drive improvement. This position has extensive interaction with cross-functional business partners at all levels, including senior management in multiple geographical locations.
A successful candidate will be proactive, confident and solution-oriented, have a broad set of work experiences within a Finance organization, and will provide a strong voice to represent Finance throughout the Controllership to arrive at solutions all cross-functional groups will find reasonable.
Your Impact
  • Identify actionable insights and drive cross-functional process improvements including, but not limited to, internal and external financial reporting, regulatory compliance, internal controls and system integration in the region
  • Lead the formulation of the Country Controlling strategy for the region to align with business needs and corporate strategy
  • Take ownership of facilitation and creation of accurate project plans with clearly defined milestones, deliverables and tasks
  • Perform monthly detailed reviews of the regional financial statements to ensure alignment with corporate reporting and local accounting GAAP reporting requirements
  • Perform month-end close for the regional entities to ensure accurate US GAAP and company policy compliant financial statements, including reviewing monthly transactions, account reconciliations, and balance sheet and income statements for reasonableness
  • Effectively provide guidance and support to GL resources in the Palo Alto Networks Center of Excellence to improve the quality, timeliness and efficiency of the regional month-end close process
  • Coordinate with IT, global and regional accounting functions, and regional third-party accounting service providers on regional system implementation projects
  • Establish effective partnerships with Palo Alto Networks Global Process Owners, Centers of Excellence and corporate and regional accounting teams to drive the incorporation of global process standards in the region
  • Establish and document all policies, process and procedures localization requirements for the region
  • Effectively manage third-party service providers in region to improve the quality, timeliness and efficiency of their services
  • Coordinate annual statutory audits for various entities in region
  • Review and approve non-routine transactions in the regional entities
  • Ensure controls and discipline are in place to achieve high employee satisfaction within the region
  • Drive cross-functional initiatives in region
  • Ensure local compliance with regional regulations, regulatory filings, and accounting rules (GAAP)
  • Effectively partner with regional and corporate FP&A and People teams to provide accounting insight and support on regional matters
  • Work with cross-functional teams on treasury and tax strategies to support compliance and the corporate goals for the region
Qualifications
Your Experience
  • At least 8-12 years of relevant experience in a medium to large size international reporting environment is required and working experience in high tech companies with prior Big 4 accounting firm experience is a plus.
  • Bachelor’s in accounting or finance – Contador or equivalent certification a plus
  • In-depth expertise, excellent working ability, and knowledge of local GAAP accounting principles, regulatory compliance and reporting requirements
  • Hands-on experience managing the accounting and financial reporting processes for international operations in the Latin American region
  • Experience with SAP or other large ERP systems
  • Proficient in US accounting standards, principles and pronouncements
  • Proven ability to work in fast-paced environments, meet challenging deadlines and priorities, deliver on multiple simultaneous projects and drive changes
  • Problem solver with strong critical thinking and project management skills
  • Demonstrated judgment in prioritizing work, identifying issues and recommending solutions, and managing multiple tasks simultaneously
  • Fluent in English, fluent in Spanish or Portuguese a plus
  • Highly collaborative with a leadership attitude to take initiative to solve problems
  • Highly proficient in Excel and Google Sheets
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build relationships and collaborate effectively, including cross-functionally
Please submit your resume in English only so that it can be properly evaluated by the Hiring team. Resumes in other languages, including Portuguese and Spanish, will not be considered for the open role.
 Additional Information
The Team
You have a passion for numbers & integration, our organization has a passion for cybersecurity. You’re looking for a career with a more fulfilling mission. We have open positions to top talent seeking a financial challenge. Our accounting department deals with numbers daily, supporting infrastructure, dealing in automation, building solutions and providing accurate, insightful financial information to empower our business lines. The ideal candidate has exceptional skills in accounting and analytics and an innovative mindset to approach finance problems differently. Our innovation doesn’t stay in Research and Development. Within finance and accounting, we seek people who are looking to try new things, while solving business critical equations. If you’re seeking a financial challenge but with a world-wide impact – this is it.
Our Commitment
We’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.
We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at
Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.
All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
Is role eligible for Immigration Sponsorship? No. Please note that we will not sponsor applicants for work visas for this position.

title: Seller Governance Specialist

description:
Faça parte do time de Heróis de Sangue Amarelo!


Nosso propósito é Tornar o Mundo um Lugar Mais Seguro e não vamos parar até conseguir, pois somos incansáveis e pensamos positivamente.

Nossa paixão? Cuidar de todos, sejam eles clientes, o planeta ou nossos colaboradores pois as pessoas são importantes para nós.

Trabalhamos todos os dias para oferecer segurança inovadora com base nas soluções mais avançadas do mercado. No Brasil, o Grupo Prosegur conta com três linhas de negócio: Segurpro, Prosegur Cash e Cipher. Viva uma excelente experiência, participando de um processo seletivo 100% digital, pois temos equipes dedicadas para garantir a qualidade, segurança e humanização em todas as etapas!


Diversidade & Inclusão na Prosegur

Cada um de nós enxerga o mundo de formas diferentes. Mas uma coisa deve ser comum a todos: o respeito. Acreditamos que a diversidade de perspectivas e experiências garantem um ambiente diferenciado de trabalho!

O Programa Somos Todos Heróis - Diversidade e Respeito vem para fortalecer e apoiar o nosso posicionamento a favor do Respeito e da Inclusão e para trazer conhecimento e conscientização a todos os nossos Heróis. Acreditamos que times diversos podem garantir resultados espetaculares além de impulsionar nossa cultura inovadora

DESCRIÇÃO DO TRABALHO

Estamos procurando um Consultor de Produtos Sênior para atuar com o desenvolvimento de produtos e assegurar alto retorno de investimento (ROI). O profissional deverá traduzir ideias em estratégias e recursos e acompanhar o desenvolvimento de produtos do início ao fim.

Um consultor de produtos sênior é um profissional que atua no desenvolvimento de projetos, identificando problemas, propondo soluções e gerenciando a relação com os departamentos do cliente. Desempenhando um papel extremamente ativo no desenvolvimento de um projeto: formulando hipóteses, propondo soluções aos problemas e executando demandas.

Para ser bem-sucedido nessa função, é preciso ser um líder perceptivo, criativo e capaz de resolver problemas. Se, além disso, você tiver uma competência excepcional para conhecer quais ideias terão ou não sucesso, gostaríamos de conhecê-lo.

Inglês e espanhol serão diferenciais importantes.

  • ·Contribuir com benchmarks, pesquisas de mercado e tendências regulatórias.

  • Colaborar com times de produto, tecnologia e jurídico em iniciativas relacionadas a ativos digitais.

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu processo de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A Dexian está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.


Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho:

- Acompanhar fornecedores de infraestrutura e garantir que entregas estejam alinhadas com os padrões definidos;

- Suportar configurações básicas e ajustes em switches, access points, roteadores e outros equipamentos de rede;

- Apoiar a equipe na manutenção de conectividade, rede Wi-Fi e serviços de telecomunicações;
